method: Production DB metadata and exact native attempt ranges; cumulative token counters minus last counter before start. Missing counters excluded,not zero. Cached input subset of input; reasoning subset of output; token_usage_record duplicate ignored. Counter reset excluded. No model calls/tests/provider operations.

consumer.matching: Outcome-blind greedy chronological before order; nearest log user-message char distance; after/before within0.8..1.25; without replacement. All initial user messages after bootstrap,not tool reads or historical context. Task category/model/effort/route/fresh fixed; facts,toolset and load not controlled.
